text: dsh-weknora-ops 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 WeKnora 命令行技能与工具入口，可通过 npm 安装并由技能目录发现。它使用配置的 WeKnora HTTP API，提供状态检查、知识库和文档查询、混合检索与带引用的知识问答，也支持上传文件、导入网页和添加手工知识；CLI 还提供标签树查看。适合需要在 DSH 中读取或维护 WeKnora 知识库的用户。运行需 Node.js 及 WeKnora API key，地址可配置，默认指向本机 127.0.0.1:8080。

dsh-weknora-ops is a WeKnora CLI skill for DeepSeek Harness. It lists knowledge bases and documents, searches with citations, answers from stored knowledge, ingests files, web pages, and text, and shows tag trees. It requires Node.js and a WeKnora API key; the API defaults to localhost:8080.
想在命令行里搜索 WeKnora 知识库并拿到出处。
怎样把本地文档或网页加入 WeKnora？
I need a cited answer grounded in a WeKnora knowledge base.
dsh-weknora-ops 的功能「检索与知识问答」：通过 search 对指定知识库执行混合检索，或用 ask 获取基于知识库的回答并返回引用；命令行传入知识库 ID 和查询或问题。
dsh-weknora-ops 的功能「知识入库」：通过 doc upload 上传本地文件、doc url 导入网页，或 doc manual 添加带标题的文本知识；命令行指定目标知识库。
dsh-weknora-ops 使用前须知：调用会把查询、问题或待入库内容发送到配置的 WeKnora API 地址，并要求配置 WEKNORA_API_KEY；配置文件默认位于用户目录下。
dsh-weknora-ops 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 9 天；提交数 8；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) plugin (skill + `weknora-ops` CLI) for [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora), the open-source knowledge-base platform.

dsh-weknora-ops README · dsh-weknora-ops：> **Relation to the official plugin**: WeKnora ships its own read-only DSH plugin, [`@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora`](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/tree/main/packages/dsh-weknora) — four query tools (list/search/read/ask), native cordis tools, contract-tested. **For querying, use theirs.** This project covers what the official one deliberately does not: the *write* path — ingest, deletion under a double gate, tag trees — plus read verbs for environments where a CLI form factor is preferred. Both can be installed side by side.

dsh-weknora-ops README · Why：Coding agents confidently hallucinate exactly the things your team wrote down somewhere: product rules, deploy procedures, compliance constraints, research conclusions. WeKnora holds that ground truth — this plugin puts it one command away and enforces a simple discipline: **cite, don't recall**.

dsh-weknora-ops README · Capabilities：| | Command | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Query** | `weknora-ops ask <kb> "<q>"` | Knowledge-grounded answer **with references** |
| | `weknora-ops search <kb> "<q>" --top-k 5` | Hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword) with cited chunks |
| | `weknora-ops kb list` / `kb show` | Knowledge bases |
| | `weknora-ops doc list <kb>` | Documents + parse status |
| | `weknora-ops tagtree <kb>` | Hierarchical tag tree (filter hint: subtree tag ids) |
| **Ingest** | `weknora-ops doc upload / url / manual` | Add documents, web pages, manual knowledge |
| **Destructive** | `weknora-ops doc delete … --yes` | Delete a document (double-gated) |

dsh-weknora-ops README · Safety model — three layers：1. **Skill etiquette** (`skills/dsh-weknora-ops/SKILL.md`): reads are agent-free; ingests only when a person asked; deletes need explicit in-conversation confirmation. Nothing in the skill grants permission — the surrounding conversation does.
2. **CLI gate**: `doc delete` refuses without `--yes`.
3. **Enforcement (the real wall)**: a workspace-scoped API key with capabilities `retrieve` / `chat` / `ingest`. A key without `manage_kbs` simply cannot do damage, whatever the agent tries — 403 is the answer, not an obstacle to work around.
dsh-weknora-ops README · Safety model — three layers：This mirrors the admission-control philosophy of [dsh-super-agent](https://github.com/vicfei/dsh-super-agent): trust is structural, not persuaded.

dsh-weknora-ops README · Status：v0.1.1 — vertical slice: 7 read verbs, 3 ingest verbs, delete gate, unit tests. **Live-tested end to end**: DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (headless, DeepSeek provider) driving `weknora-ops` against a real WeKnora v3.1.3 server — skill discovery, `status`, `kb list` (542 KBs), `search` with cited hits; the run also caught and fixed two real integration bugs (env scrubbing → config file; `query_text`/`match_count` on v0.8.0-line servers). `ask` follows the v5-line session flow — on older servers the skill falls back to `search` + synthesis. Streaming answers, agent-chat operations and an MCP-endpoint mode are on the [roadmap](docs/DESIGN.md).

dsh-weknora-ops README · 为什么做：编码智能体最自信满满胡编的，恰恰是团队早就写在某处的东西：产品规则、部署规程、合规约束、研究结论。WeKnora 存着这些事实源头——本插件把它放到一条命令的距离内，并强制一条纪律：**引用，而不是回忆**。

dsh-weknora-ops README · 能力面：| | 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **查询** | `weknora-ops ask <kb> "<问题>"` | 基于 knowledge-grounded 的回答，**附引用** |
| | `weknora-ops search <kb> "<查询>" --top-k 5` | 混合检索（向量+关键词），返回带出处的分块 |
| | `weknora-ops kb list` / `kb show` | 知识库列表/详情 |
| | `weknora-ops doc list <kb>` | 文档列表 + 解析状态 |
| | `weknora-ops tagtree <kb>` | 层级标签树（子树 tag_id 可作过滤提示） |
| **入库** | `weknora-ops doc upload / url / manual` | 上传文档 / 网页 / 手工知识 |
| **破坏性** | `weknora-ops doc delete … --yes` | 删除文档（双重门禁） |

dsh-weknora-ops README · 安全模型——三层：1. **技能礼仪**（`skills/dsh-weknora-ops/SKILL.md`）：读操作随用；入库仅当真人要求；删除须对话中明确确认。技能文本本身不授予任何许可——授权来自周围的人。
2. **CLI 闸门**：`doc delete` 不带 `--yes` 直接拒绝。
3. **强制层（真正的墙）**：空间级 scoped API Key，只给 `retrieve` / `chat` / `ingest` 能力。没有 `manage_kbs` 的钥匙做不了破坏——智能体怎么试都一样，403 就是答案，不是要绕开的障碍。

这与 [dsh-super-agent](https://github.com/vicfei/dsh-super-agent) 的准入控制哲学同源：信任是结构性的，不是提示词劝出来的。

npm i -g dsh-weknora-ops        # 暴露 weknora-ops CLI

dsh-weknora-ops README · 凭据 —— DSH 的 agent shell 会擦洗 *KEY* 环境变量，配置文件是 DSH 内的主渠道；env 在 CI/运维场景仍然有效：mkdir -p ~/.config/weknora-ops && chmod 700 ~/.config/weknora-ops
cat > ~/.config/weknora-ops/config <<'EOF'   # 空间级 key：WeKnora 设置 → API Keys，能力勾 retrieve/chat/ingest
export WEKNORA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080
export WEKNORA_API_KEY=wk-…
EOF
chmod 600 ~/.config/weknora-ops/config

weknora-ops status   # 健康检查 + 认证探测
```
